checks.name: every subscription is present, including one with no activity
only real subscriptions
checks.sql: select count(*) from main.rpt_subscription_activity where subscription_id not in (select subscription_id from raw.subscriptions)

checks.name: a subscription with no activity counts zero, not NULL
checks.sql: select count(*) from main.rpt_subscription_activity where activity_count = 0 and last_activity_at is null

checks.name: activity counts and last activity match
checks.sql: select count(*) from main.rpt_subscription_activity r join (select s.subscription_id, count(a.activity_id) as n, max(a.occurred_at) as last_at from raw.subscriptions s left join raw.activity a using (subscription_id) group by 1) e using (subscription_id) where r.activity_count is distinct from e.n or r.last_activity_at is distinct from e.last_at
